```{r, echo = F, message = F}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(marginaleffects)
library(sandwich)
library(here)

load(here("models", "ICB_models.RData"))
```

# Common settings and functions
```{r, echo = F}
# ============================================================
# Common settings and functions
# ============================================================

military_probs <- c(0, 1)

# Upper limit of the x-axis (only the US exceeds 4e8)
military_max <- 4e8

get_model_data <- function(model) {

  used_rows <- rownames(model.frame(model))

  positions <- match(
    used_rows,
    rownames(matched_caliper)
  )

  if (anyNA(positions)) {
    stop("Some model observations could not be matched to matched_caliper.")
  }

  matched_caliper[
    positions,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
}


get_model_data_nonUS <- function(model) {

  used_rows <- rownames(model.frame(model))

  positions <- match(
    used_rows,
    rownames(matched_nonUS)
  )

  if (anyNA(positions)) {
    stop("Some model observations could not be matched to matched_nonUS.")
  }

  matched_nonUS[
    positions,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
}

make_controls <- function(data, n) {

  regime_difference_value <- if (
    is.factor(data$regime_type_difference)
  ) {
    if ("1" %in% levels(data$regime_type_difference)) {
      "1"
    } else {
      levels(data$regime_type_difference)[1]
    }
  } else {
    1
  }

  data.frame(
    regime_type_difference = rep(
      regime_difference_value,
      n
    ),
    coldwar = rep(1, n),
    relative_power = rep(
      mean(data$relative_power, na.rm = TRUE),
      n
    ),
    contiguous_intervener = rep(1, n),
    milint = rep(
      mean(data$milint, na.rm = TRUE),
      n
    ),
    contiguous_actors = rep(1, n),
    protrac = rep(1, n),
    gravcr = rep(0, n)
  )
}


make_controls_with_US <- function(data, n) {
  cbind(
    make_controls(data, n),
    US_involvement = rep(1, n)
  )
}

# Moderator values: mean - 1 SD and mean + 1 SD
get_mean_sd <- function(data, variable) {

  x <- data[[variable]]

  mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) +
    c(-1, 1) * sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}


# Rug only shows observations within the x-axis range
rug_data <- function(data) {
  data[
    !is.na(data$military_expenditure_int) &
      data$military_expenditure_int <= military_max,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
}


get_military_sequence <- function(data, n = 100) {

  military_values <- data$military_expenditure_int

  military_values <- military_values[
    is.finite(military_values) &
      military_values > 0 &
      military_values <= military_max
  ]

  military_limits <- quantile(
    military_values,
    probs = military_probs,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )

  exp(
    seq(
      log(military_limits[1]),
      log(military_limits[2]),
      length.out = n
    )
  )
}


cluster_predictions <- function(model, newdata) {

  cluster_vcov <- sandwich::vcovCL(
    model,
    cluster = ~ crisno,
    type = "HC3"
  )

  pred <- marginaleffects::predictions(
    model,
    newdata = newdata,
    vcov = cluster_vcov,
    type = "response"
  )

  data.frame(
    newdata,
    fit = pred$estimate,
    lower = pmax(pred$conf.low, 0),
    upper = pmin(pred$conf.high, 1)
  )
}


common_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

# Long-term Results

H1.1 Regime Type
```{r, echo = F}
model_data_1.1 <- get_model_data(
  h1.1_without_US
)

pred_data_1.1 <- cbind(
  data.frame(
    regime_type_int = c(0, 1)
  ),
  make_controls(
    model_data_1.1,
    n = 2
  )
)

pred_df_1.1 <- cluster_predictions(
  h1.1_without_US,
  pred_data_1.1
)

pred_df_1.1$regime_group <- factor(
  pred_df_1.1$regime_type_int,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c(
    "Non-Democracy",
    "Democracy"
  )
)

figure_1.1 <- ggplot(
  pred_df_1.1,
  aes(
    x = regime_group,
    y = fit
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    color = "steelblue"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    width = 0.1,
    color = "steelblue"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Intervener Regime Type",
    y = "Predicted Probability of Tension Reduction",
    title = "Regime Type (Long-term)",
    subtitle = "95% crisis-clustered HC3 confidence intervals"
  ) +
  common_theme

figure_1.1
```

H1.3 Regime Type * Military Expenditure
```{r, echo = F}
model_data_1.3 <- get_model_data(
  h1.3_without_US
)

military_values_1.3 <- get_military_sequence(
  model_data_1.3
)

pred_data_1.3 <- expand.grid(
  military_expenditure_int = military_values_1.3,
  regime_type_int = c(0, 1)
)

pred_data_1.3 <- cbind(
  pred_data_1.3,
  ties_to_both_sides = mean(
    model_data_1.3$ties_to_both_sides,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  make_controls(
    model_data_1.3,
    n = nrow(pred_data_1.3)
  )
)

pred_df_1.3 <- cluster_predictions(
  h1.3_without_US,
  pred_data_1.3
)

pred_df_1.3$regime_group <- factor(
  pred_df_1.3$regime_type_int,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c(
    "Non-Democracy",
    "Democracy"
  )
)

figure_1.3 <- ggplot(
  pred_df_1.3,
  aes(
    x = military_expenditure_int,
    y = fit,
    color = regime_group,
    fill = regime_group
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_rug(
    data = rug_data(model_data_1.3),
    aes(
      x = military_expenditure_int
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      big.mark = ","
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Intervener Military Expenditure (log scale)",
    y = "Predicted Probability of Tension Reduction",
    color = "Regime Type",
    fill = "Regime Type",
    title = "Regime Type \u00D7 Military Expenditure (Long-term)",
    subtitle = "95% crisis-clustered HC3 confidence intervals"
  ) +
  common_theme
```


# Short-term Results

```{r, echo = F}
# ============================================================
# Plotting functions for short-term models
# ============================================================

# Main-effect plots: H2.1 and H2.2
make_main_effect_plot <- function(
  model,
  variable,
  values,
  value_labels,
  x_label,
  figure_title
) {

  model_data <- get_model_data(model)

  pred_data <- data.frame(values)
  names(pred_data) <- variable

  pred_data <- cbind(
    pred_data,
    make_controls(
      model_data,
      n = nrow(pred_data)
    )
  )

  pred_df <- cluster_predictions(
    model,
    pred_data
  )

  pred_df$display_group <- factor(
    pred_df[[variable]],
    levels = values,
    labels = value_labels
  )

  ggplot(
    pred_df,
    aes(
      x = display_group,
      y = fit
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 3,
      color = "steelblue"
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper
      ),
      width = 0.1,
      color = "steelblue"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format()
    ) +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = "Predicted Probability of Agreement",
      title = figure_title,
      subtitle = "95% crisis-clustered HC3 confidence intervals"
    ) +
    common_theme
}


# Military expenditure interaction plots: H2.3, H2.4, H2.8, H2.9, H2.10
make_military_interaction_plot <- function(
  model,
  moderator,
  moderator_values,
  moderator_labels,
  legend_title,
  figure_title
) {

  model_data <- get_model_data(model)

  military_values <- get_military_sequence(
    model_data
  )

  pred_data <- expand.grid(
    military_expenditure_int = military_values,
    moderator_value = moderator_values
  )

  names(pred_data)[2] <- moderator

  pred_data <- cbind(
    pred_data,
    ties_to_both_sides = mean(
      model_data$ties_to_both_sides,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    make_controls(
      model_data,
      n = nrow(pred_data)
    )
  )

  pred_df <- cluster_predictions(
    model,
    pred_data
  )

  pred_df$moderator_group <- factor(
    pred_df[[moderator]],
    levels = moderator_values,
    labels = moderator_labels
  )

  ggplot(
    pred_df,
    aes(
      x = military_expenditure_int,
      y = fit,
      color = moderator_group,
      fill = moderator_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper
      ),
      alpha = 0.15,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_rug(
      data = rug_data(model_data),
      aes(
        x = military_expenditure_int
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(
      labels = scales::label_number(
        big.mark = ","
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format()
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Intervener Military Expenditure (log scale)",
      y = "Predicted Probability of Agreement",
      color = legend_title,
      fill = legend_title,
      title = figure_title,
      subtitle = "95% crisis-clustered HC3 confidence intervals"
    ) +
    common_theme
}


# Ties interaction plots: H2.5, H2.6, H2.7, H2.11, H2.12
make_ties_interaction_plot <- function(
  model,
  moderator,
  moderator_values,
  moderator_labels,
  legend_title,
  figure_title
) {

  model_data <- get_model_data(model)

  typical_military <- median(
    model_data$military_expenditure_int[
      model_data$military_expenditure_int > 0
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  pred_data <- expand.grid(
    ties_to_both_sides = c(0, 1),
    moderator_value = moderator_values
  )

  names(pred_data)[2] <- moderator

  pred_data <- cbind(
    pred_data,
    military_expenditure_int = typical_military,
    make_controls(
      model_data,
      n = nrow(pred_data)
    )
  )

  pred_df <- cluster_predictions(
    model,
    pred_data
  )

  pred_df$ties_group <- factor(
    pred_df$ties_to_both_sides,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    labels = c(
      "No Ties",
      "Ties to Both Sides"
    )
  )

  pred_df$moderator_group <- factor(
    pred_df[[moderator]],
    levels = moderator_values,
    labels = moderator_labels
  )

  plot_position <- position_dodge(
    width = 0.2
  )

  ggplot(
    pred_df,
    aes(
      x = ties_group,
      y = fit,
      color = moderator_group,
      group = moderator_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      position = plot_position,
      size = 3
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper
      ),
      position = plot_position,
      width = 0.1
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format()
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Ties to Both Sides",
      y = "Predicted Probability of Agreement",
      color = legend_title,
      title = figure_title,
      subtitle = "95% crisis-clustered HC3 confidence intervals"
    ) +
    common_theme
}
```

## Short-term Results

```{r, echo = F}
# ============================================================
# Plotting functions for short-term models (with US involvement)
# Same as make_main_effect_plot / make_military_interaction_plot /
# make_ties_interaction_plot, except that they use
# make_controls_with_US() instead of make_controls()
# ============================================================

make_main_effect_plot_with_US <- function(
  model,
  variable,
  values,
  value_labels,
  x_label,
  figure_title
) {

  model_data <- get_model_data(model)

  pred_data <- data.frame(values)
  names(pred_data) <- variable

  pred_data <- cbind(
    pred_data,
    make_controls_with_US(
      model_data,
      n = nrow(pred_data)
    )
  )

  pred_df <- cluster_predictions(
    model,
    pred_data
  )

  pred_df$display_group <- factor(
    pred_df[[variable]],
    levels = values,
    labels = value_labels
  )

  ggplot(
    pred_df,
    aes(
      x = display_group,
      y = fit
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 3,
      color = "steelblue"
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper
      ),
      width = 0.1,
      color = "steelblue"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format()
    ) +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = "Predicted Probability of Agreement",
      title = figure_title,
      subtitle = "Robustness check (US Involvement = 1); 95% crisis-clustered HC3 confidence intervals"
    ) +
    common_theme
}


make_military_interaction_plot_with_US <- function(
  model,
  moderator,
  moderator_values,
  moderator_labels,
  legend_title,
  figure_title
) {

  model_data <- get_model_data(model)

  military_values <- get_military_sequence(
    model_data
  )

  pred_data <- expand.grid(
    military_expenditure_int = military_values,
    moderator_value = moderator_values
  )

  names(pred_data)[2] <- moderator

  pred_data <- cbind(
    pred_data,
    ties_to_both_sides = mean(
      model_data$ties_to_both_sides,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    make_controls_with_US(
      model_data,
      n = nrow(pred_data)
    )
  )

  pred_df <- cluster_predictions(
    model,
    pred_data
  )

  pred_df$moderator_group <- factor(
    pred_df[[moderator]],
    levels = moderator_values,
    labels = moderator_labels
  )

  ggplot(
    pred_df,
    aes(
      x = military_expenditure_int,
      y = fit,
      color = moderator_group,
      fill = moderator_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper
      ),
      alpha = 0.15,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_rug(
      data = rug_data(model_data),
      aes(
        x = military_expenditure_int
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(
      labels = scales::label_number(
        big.mark = ","
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format()
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Intervener Military Expenditure (log scale)",
      y = "Predicted Probability of Agreement",
      color = legend_title,
      fill = legend_title,
      title = figure_title,
      subtitle = "Robustness check (US Involvement = 1); 95% crisis-clustered HC3 confidence intervals"
    ) +
    common_theme
}


make_ties_interaction_plot_with_US <- function(
  model,
  moderator,
  moderator_values,
  moderator_labels,
  legend_title,
  figure_title
) {

  model_data <- get_model_data(model)

  typical_military <- median(
    model_data$military_expenditure_int[
      model_data$military_expenditure_int > 0
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  pred_data <- expand.grid(
    ties_to_both_sides = c(0, 1),
    moderator_value = moderator_values
  )

  names(pred_data)[2] <- moderator

  pred_data <- cbind(
    pred_data,
    military_expenditure_int = typical_military,
    make_controls_with_US(
      model_data,
      n = nrow(pred_data)
    )
  )

  pred_df <- cluster_predictions(
    model,
    pred_data
  )

  pred_df$ties_group <- factor(
    pred_df$ties_to_both_sides,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    labels = c(
      "No Ties",
      "Ties to Both Sides"
    )
  )

  pred_df$moderator_group <- factor(
    pred_df[[moderator]],
    levels = moderator_values,
    labels = moderator_labels
  )

  plot_position <- position_dodge(
    width = 0.2
  )

  ggplot(
    pred_df,
    aes(
      x = ties_group,
      y = fit,
      color = moderator_group,
      group = moderator_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      position = plot_position,
      size = 3
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper
      ),
      position = plot_position,
      width = 0.1
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format()
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Ties to Both Sides",
      y = "Predicted Probability of Agreement",
      color = legend_title,
      title = figure_title,
      subtitle = "Robustness check (US Involvement = 1); 95% crisis-clustered HC3 confidence intervals"
    ) +
    common_theme
}
```

# Export: Core Finding Plots
```{r, echo = F}
# Figures 2-7 in the paper (main models, without US involvement)
core_plots <- list(
  "Figure 2 - Regime Type x Military Expenditure (Agreement)" = figure_2.3,
  "Figure 3 - Personalism x Military Expenditure (Agreement)" = figure_2.4,
  "Figure 4 - Regime Type x Ties to Both Sides (Tension Reduction)" = figure_1.5,
  "Figure 5 - Human Rights x Ties to Both Sides (Tension Reduction)" = figure_1.7,
  "Figure 6 - Personalism x Ties to Both Sides (Tension Reduction)" = figure_1.6,
  "Figure 7 - Personalism x Ties to Both Sides (Agreement)" = figure_2.6
)

for (plot_name in names(core_plots)) {
  ggsave(
    here("Plots", "Core Finding Plots", paste0(plot_name, ".png")),
    core_plots[[plot_name]],
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```

# Export: Other Plots
```{r, echo = F}
# All remaining figures: main models not used in the paper body,
# and all robustness models (with US involvement)
core_plot_objects <- c(
  "figure_2.3", "figure_2.4", "figure_1.5",
  "figure_1.7", "figure_1.6", "figure_2.6"
)

other_plot_objects <- setdiff(
  ls(pattern = "^figure_[12]\\.[0-9]+(_with_US)?$"),
  core_plot_objects
)

for (object_name in other_plot_objects) {

  plot_object <- get(object_name)

  hypothesis <- sub("^figure_([12]\\.[0-9]+).*$", "H\\1", object_name)

  outcome <- if (startsWith(hypothesis, "H1")) {
    "Tension Reduction"
  } else {
    "Agreement"
  }

  plot_title <- sub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", plot_object$labels$title)
  plot_title <- gsub(" × ", " x ", plot_title)

  sub_folder <- if (grepl("_with_US$", object_name)) {
    "Robustness - US Involvement"
  } else {
    "Main Models"
  }

  dir.create(
    here("Plots", "Other Plots", sub_folder),
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  ggsave(
    here(
      "Plots",
      "Other Plots",
      sub_folder,
      paste0(hypothesis, " - ", plot_title, " (", outcome, ").png")
    ),
    plot_object,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```
